title: DynaContext: Self-Improving Dynamic Contextualization of Optimized Prompts for Heterogeneous Parameter Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2608.22014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated prompt and skill optimization typically produces a single static instruction that is reused across inference instances until the next optimization cycle. However, this approach cannot adapt when the required context, constraints, and evidence vary from one instance to another. For instance, parameter extraction from electronic component descriptions breaks this assumption: resistors, capacitors, transistors, and connectors require different fields, unit constraints, and demonstrations, and each input provides a different evidence state. We introduce DynaContext, a framework that combines an offline-optimized extraction core, learned with GEPA or SkillOpt, with inference-time contextual adaptation and validation-gated self-improvement. translated_title: DynaContext：面向异构参数提取的优化提示词动态上下文化的自我改进框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22014v1 公告类型：新  摘要：自动提示词和技能优化通常会产生一个单一的静态指令，该指令在推理实例之间重复使用，直到下一个优化周期。然而，当所需上下文、约束和证据因实例而异时，这种方法无法适应。例如，从电子元件描述中提取参数就打破了这一假设：电阻、电容、晶体管和连接器需要不同的字段、单位约束和示例，且每个输入提供不同的证据状态。我们引入了DynaContext，一个结合了离线优化提取核心（通过GEPA或SkillOpt学习）与推理时上下文适应和验证门控自我改进的框架。DynaContext将每个条目路由到内部、外部或回退证据路径，并从核心、模式、证据、未解析字段和已验证示例中组合出特定于条目的提示。
tldr: DynaContext通过结合离线优化核心与推理时的动态上下文适应及验证门控自我改进，解决了静态提示无法适应异构参数提取中每实例变化需求的问题。
en_tdlr: DynaContext addresses the limitation of static prompts in heterogeneous parameter extraction by combining an offline-optimized core with inference-time dynamic contextual adaptation and validation-gated self-improvement.
